title: Security Room Surveillance
description: A dimly lit security office features a wooden desk with six CRT monitors displaying empty institutional hallways labeled with camera numbers. A large screen shows a man in a dark jacket standing in a room facing a framed picture on the wall, his back visible from behind. The desk holds a vintage telephone, green banker's lamp, mug, papers, flashlight, keys, and a handwritten note.
prompt: A moody security monitoring room with purple walls and a cluttered wooden desk under a green banker's lamp. Six old CRT monitors show empty sterile hallways with camera labels. One large monitor displays a man from behind standing in a green room pointing at a framed picture on the wall. Desk contains vintage telephone, coffee mug, papers, flashlight, keys and a note. Cinematic lighting, atmospheric and unsettling, realistic painting style.
